purpose: Teach: どん底/城壁/順応/蒸発/牽制/発着/老齢/海戦

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 蓮さん、患者さんがどん底の状態でも医療チームで支えます
lines.en: Ren — even when patients are at their lowest, our medical team stands with them.
lines.style: Measured and steady. Open naturally on the name, then shift into quiet certainty. Warm without softness. The voice of someone who has seen this work.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい、感染症から守る城壁となる対策を医療チームで講じます
lines.en: Yes — we've put safeguards in place as a team to protect against infection.
lines.style: Calm, methodical. Each phrase lands with careful weight. No rush. The tone of someone explaining something she has explained many times and means every time.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 治療への順応性を、貴院、丁寧に診ておられますね、先生
lines.en: You've really watched how carefully this hospital assesses each patient's ability to adapt to treatment, haven't you, Doctor?
lines.style: Thoughtful, slightly hesitant. Genuine question wrapped in observation. Respectful distance. A pause before 'Doctor' — checking himself for sounding too keen.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい、急な蒸発症状にも医療チームで対応します
lines.en: Yes — our team is equipped to respond even to sudden, unexpected complications.
lines.style: Steady, reassuring. Slight emphasis on 'equipped.' Voice level, no performance. The ground-truth confidence of someone who trusts her team.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 競合病院との不要な牽制は、貴院、避けられてますね、先生
lines.en: I've noticed this hospital doesn't get caught up in needless competition with other facilities, does it, Doctor?
lines.style: Quiet observation, almost to himself. Respectful, not flattering. A soft landing on the final question. He's noticing something real and testing if it's safe to say aloud.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい、患者さんの発着情報を医療チームで把握します
lines.en: Yes — we keep detailed records of each patient's arrivals and departures as a team.
lines.style: Clear and factual. No unnecessary warmth, but not cold either. The voice of someone sharing routine protocol that is anything but routine to patients.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 老齢患者の専門ケアを、貴院、強化されてますね、先生
lines.en: Your hospital seems to have really strengthened its specialized care for older patients, hasn't it, Doctor?
lines.style: Gentle inquiry with respect underneath. Noticing something specific. A touch of warmth in the observation. Small pause before the honorific — acknowledging the distance between them.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい、海戦時の医療事例を医療チームで参考にします
lines.en: Yes — we draw on medical lessons learned from past situations to guide how we care today.
lines.style: Thoughtful pause at the start. Speaking carefully, choosing words with weight. No cynicism. The tone of someone who learned hard lessons and chose to apply them with grace.
